E4Plus1.uk.description: What do the Goggleboxers think of The Graham Norton Show; Mary Berry - Love to Cook; Celebrity Antiques Road Trip; Strictly; The Lakes with Simon Reeve; and Sex: Unzipped? (S18 Ep10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Naked Attraction
E4Plus1.uk.description: A celebration of Naked Attraction's very best naughty bits, revisiting times when the pickers got it spot on and chose their perfect date, including Gemma and James who found love.

E4Plus1.uk.title: First Dates
E4Plus1.uk.description: Neuroscientist and self-confessed geek Michael is yet to find someone with the right kind of chemistry. His date Hannah hopes that her dream man exists outside her romance novels. (S12 Ep3) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Below Deck
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: The crew pick up the pieces after Hurricane Kelly - and boy are there a lot of pieces to pick up. And Jess faces the consequences of her actions at the villa. (S12 Ep10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Regina Monologues: The Simpsons go to London with $1000 that Bart found, but Homer crashes the hire car into the Queen and gets locked in the Tower. Tony Blair guest stars. (S15 Ep4/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Abbott Elementary
E4Plus1.uk.description: Holiday Hookah: On the last day of school before winter break, Janine's friend convinces her to go to a popular club, where they bump into her colleagues... (S2 Ep10) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: Ho-ly K.I.T.T.: A shared love of the TV show Knight Rider brings Murray and his brother Marvin together. Beverly invites Lainey and Bill to Thanksgiving dinner. (S4 Ep7)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Greatest Musical Ever Written: Barry makes fun of Adam for taking part in a school musical. Beverly's job as a substitute teacher causes problems for Erica. (S4 Ep8)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
E4Plus1.uk.description: Save Our Town: Gordon helps three businesses in Ellicott City, Maryland, which suffered flood damage in 2016 and 2018. The job is so huge that Gordon dumps the 24-hour time limit. (S3 Ep10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Phil on Wire: Jay's relationship with the dog irritates Gloria. Phil and Luke try to master the tightrope. Cameron starts a juice fast. (S3 Ep3)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Door to Door: Jay helps Manny with a school fundraiser. Claire campaigns for a stop sign at a busy junction. Phil and Luke try to create a viral video. Gloria searches for Stella. (S3 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Rude(ish) Tube Shorts
E4Plus1.uk.description: A short, cheeky clip from Rude Tube's naughty little sister, Rude(ish) Tube, featuring sports of the lawnmower, motorbike and bicycle variety.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
E4Plus1.uk.description: In West Yorkshire, Sophie and Harj plan a Mexican menu, but can Harj find his way around the kitchen? Richard and Libby stick to British classics. Butcher Sean and Jane serve a meat feast.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Mixing Bowl: Bijou New York diner The Mixing Bowl is haemorrhaging money thanks to manager Mike's out-of-control marketing plans. Can Gordon get things back on track? (S1 Ep2) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Seascape: Gordon Ramsay visits the Seascape restaurant in the seaside village of Islip, on Long Island in New York, where owner Peter has nearly a million dollars of debt. (S1 Ep3)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Below Deck
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: The crew pick up the pieces after Hurricane Kelly - and boy are there a lot of pieces to pick up. And Jess faces the consequences of her actions at the villa. (S12 Ep10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Fifteen Percent: Mitchell seeks revenge when Jay introduces Cameron as just his 'friend'. Gloria gives Manny's date a makeover. (S1 Ep13)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Moon Landing: Claire feels slightly inadequate when her old friend, Valerie (guest star Minnie Driver), visits and is nothing like Claire remembered. (S1 Ep14)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Realty Bites: Marge takes a job with Lionel Hutz's estate agency, but begins to question her morals when she has to try to sell the infamous Murder House to Ned Flanders. (S9 Ep9/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace: When Bart destroys the family's Christmas tree and presents, his lies about a burglar stealing them spiral out of control. (S9 Ep10/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: All Singing, All Dancing: The Simpsons remember all the great songs from their eventful lives after renting the movie Paint Your Wagon. With the guest voice of George Harrison. (S9 Ep11/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Bart Carny: Homer and Bart start working at the fairground, but because of Homer's stupidity, a fair worker and his son lose their jobs. So they steal the Simpsons' house. (S9 Ep12/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Your Honor: Captain Holt's mother seeks help from the precinct. Jeffords, Diaz and Boyle redecorate the breakroom. Santiago teaches Gina how to change a tyre. (S4 Ep19)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Slaughterhouse: Peralta and Diaz try to earn the respect of their idol, Lt Melanie Hawkins, after accidentally disrupting one of her undercover cases. (S4 Ep20)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Mother Tucker: Cameron loves his mum, so Mitchell isn't sure how to tell Cam that she makes him uncomfortable. When Haley breaks up with Dylan, Phil takes it harder than anyone. (S2 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Dance Dance Revelation: Everyone gets in on the fun at Luke and Manny's first school dance. A trip to the mall with the boys becomes stressful for Jay and Phil. (S2 Ep10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Slow Down Your Neighbors: Claire becomes a determined neighbourhood vigilante hoping to catch and stop a menacing car that speeds through the streets. (S2 Ep11)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Our Children, Ourselves: Claire and Phil want Alex to relax about her studies, but then question their own intellectual drives. And Gloria tries to befriend another nice couple. (S2 Ep12)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Fat and the Furriest: Homer is a laughing stock when he's caught on tape running from a bear at the dump, so he hunts down the bear in an attempt to regain his dignity. (S15 Ep5/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Today I Am a Clown: Homer is a huge success when he fills in for Krusty on TV. Guest starring Mr T and Jackie Mason. (S15 Ep6/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: 'Tis the Fifteenth Season: After seeing A Christmas Carol on TV, Homer realises he's been too selfish and decides to make amends, culminating in a 'nice-off' with Ned Flanders. (S15 Ep7/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Marge vs. Singles, Seniors, Childless Couples and Teens, and Gays: When a baby riot breaks out at a children's concert, the town's childless community form an anti-youth lobby. (S15 Ep8/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Kids Are All Fight: When Homer finds an old roll of film and has it developed, the family take a trip down memory lane to when Bart and Lisa were always fighting. (S26 Ep19/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Let's Go Fly a Coot: Bart develops a crush on Milhouse's Dutch cousin. And the family learn about Grampa's days in the Air Force. (S26 Ep20/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Below Deck
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: The crew celebrate Kyle's birthday. But his bruised ego causes him to lash out at Solène and reveal a shocking secret that could change everything. (S12 Ep11)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: On the 'Box this time: I'm a Celebrity... Get Me Out of Here!, Tiger King 2, An Audience with Adele, Michael McIntyre's The Wheel, Close to Me, and BBC/ITV News (Austria). (S18 Ep11)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
